name: system-document-tags-with-ids
description: Two <document> blocks in an OpenAI system message. The first has a valid id attribute, which becomes the item id; the second only has a title, so it gets the fallback sys2 (second request_system item). system_instructions is the system text without the blocks; the resulting run of 7 newlines collapses to 2.

messages.content:
You are Acme support. Answer from the documents below.

<document id="refund-policy">Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase.</document>


<document title="Shipping">Orders ship within 2 business days.</document>

Be brief.

items.text: Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase.
